question: If the electric flux through a surface between the plates of a capacitor remains constant with time, what is the displacement current? Justify your answer.

options.A: $I_D=\varepsilon_0\Phi_E$, so it remains a nonzero constant.
options.B: $I_D$ increases continuously because electric flux is present.
options.C: $I_D$ depends only on area, so a constant flux gives a constant nonzero current.
options.D: $I_D=\varepsilon_0\dfrac{d\Phi_E}{dt}$. If electric flux is constant, $\dfrac{d\Phi_E}{dt}=0$, so $I_D=0$.
